key_findings: desktop_actions_mac.mm is 143 lines and currently owns notifications, ServiceManagement login-item registration and Sparkle; no NSMenu, NSStatusItem, hotkey, dock-menu or QuickLook implementation exists.
Main.qml already has a commandEntries catalog with stable IDs, enabled/reason state, shortcut text and runCommand dispatch; it is untyped QML rather than a typed C++ catalog.
The Batch 2 and 3 rows compile against the existing desktop targets with no Qt rebuild; Dock menu alone would introduce Qt Widgets.
Offscreen check_ui_preview.py cannot accept native menu-bar, status-item, Dock, QuickLook, Focus or secure-input behavior; new native fixtures are required.
native_menu_worker.search_note: The worker attempted sindexer first; its sandbox could not create the wrapper temp file, so rg was the recorded fallback.

quality_goals_worker.use: Not accepted as evidence; the coordinator independently confirmed the Q03 diagnostic coupling and the Q04/Q05/Q13 file duplication.

coordinator_confirmations: services/session/src/session_service.cpp schedule_attention still starts the full attention interval when the timer is inactive.
apps/ios/Lapis/Models.swift followNewHistory still sleeps a full second before its first loadNewer after idle.
apps/desktop/src/attention_view.cpp applyAttention still infers awaiting_first_prompt from exact diagnostic strings.
wire::AttentionSnapshot in services/session/src/transport/attention_protocol.hpp has no observation-phase field, confirming that Q03 needs a compatibility decision before a sub-agent edits it.
apps/desktop/tests/live_connection_test.cpp and terminal_input_test.cpp each define an identical Peer fixture helper, confirming Q13's bounded scope.

apps/desktop/src/live_connection.cpp is 585 lines and couples transport, descriptor persistence, snapshot handling and history requests, confirming Q05 is a seam review rather than a blind extraction.
